value.rationale: A natural uniform position/heading ensemble with a fully absorbing boundary resolves the apparent chirality ambiguity in the motivating fixed-start/mixed-boundary literature at weak propulsion. A strictly completely monotone response in squared chirality yields infinitely many qualitative derivative inequalities and a geometry-dependent spectral measure, not a routine benchmark number. This identifies the hypothesis that separates monotone response from physical optimal-chirality phenomena.
